common.name: Lists card
common.description: Any list an entity holds, such as tasks, events or notices, grouped by time or by a key
common.invalid_configuration: Invalid configuration. Each entry under lists needs an entity, more entities (entities) are for a calendar's list only, group must be time, key, month or none, limit a whole number, order a list of before, now, after and done, and a tone plain, warning, highlight or dimmed.
common.invalid_layout: Invalid layout. Layout must be rows or timeline.
common.invalid_text: Invalid text mode. Text must be full, clamp or fold.
common.invalid_headings: Invalid headings. Headings must be plain or fold.
common.invalid_height: Invalid height. The heights (height and max_height) must be positive numbers in pixels, and the height mode (height_mode) auto, fixed or max.
common.invalid_row_step: Invalid rounding. The rounding (row_step) must be full or half.
common.invalid_editing: Invalid editing. Editing (editing) must be full, tick or none.
common.no_lists: No lists yet. Add one in the card's settings.
common.save_failed: The change didn't go through. Try again.

editor.title: Title
editor.text_helper: Cut or folded, a tap on the item opens it.
editor.editing: Changing a to-do list on the card
editor.editing_helper: With ticks only, items can be ticked and unticked, but not added, edited or deleted.
editor.lists_helper: A card with one list shows that list's groups. With several lists, each list is shown under its own name instead, with no groups inside it.
editor.add_list_helper: Pick the entity whose list is shown. A calendar or a to-do list is read as it is, otherwise the list's keys are set on its page.
editor.entities_helper: These calendars' events are shown in the same list, such as the public holidays among your own events. A calendar can have a colour of its own.
editor.color_helper: The colour of the vertical line beside the items. By default the theme's primary colour is used.
editor.attribute_helper: The attribute that holds the list's items. Left empty, the items are read from the entity's state as JSON.
editor.path_helper: Only when the items are deeper inside the attribute, for example data.items.
editor.name: Name
editor.name_helper: The list's heading on a card with several lists. Left empty, the entity's name is used.
editor.fields_helper: Which key of a list's item holds each field. A key left empty is the field's own name, and a key may be a path, for example attributes.title.
editor.days_back_helper: How many days back items that are over are shown. If the field is empty, no day limit is used.
editor.days_back_calendar_helper: How many days back the events are fetched (max. 365). If the field is empty, the events are fetched from the past year.
editor.days_ahead_helper: How many days ahead items to come are shown. If the field is empty, no day limit is used.
editor.days_ahead_calendar_helper: How many days ahead the events are fetched (max. 365). If the field is empty, the events are fetched a year ahead.
editor.limit_helper: The most items shown, 100 at most. If there are more items than can be shown, the card says how many were left out.
editor.past_limit_helper: How many items that are over are shown. They count toward the total, and past events are always shown starting from the latest. 0 means no history is shown.
editor.hide_more: Hide how many were left out
editor.hide_more_helper: The list is cut to the set maximum, and how many were left out isn't shown.
editor.order_helper: The items of a group left out aren't shown.
editor.order_todo_helper: The items of a group left out aren't shown. Ticked holds the items ticked on a to-do list.
editor.bucket_days_helper: Items further away are left out. Left empty, there is no limit in days.
editor.bucket_farthest_first_helper: Usually the items nearest today come first.
editor.row_step_helper: On automatic rows the card's height is rounded up to whole rows, or to half rows to save room.
